messages:
marcus: Quick decision thread after the outage: propose clear expectations so on-call can publish without a ton of back-and-forth. Draft: public blurb within 24h, technical addendum within 72h when impact threshold met, full RCA only on request (intake + approvals). Thoughts?

ivy: +1. Keep public blurb one short paragraph. Addendum should include timeline, impact numbers, mitigations, and a recurrence status line.

leo: For recurrence detection, suggest thresholds: >=2 similar incidents in 30 days OR >=3 in 90 days. If flagged, add a single-line callout in the addendum with remediation owner + provisional ETA.

legal-bot: Recommend neutral, factual phrasing. Example recurrence sentence: "We have observed instances with similar characteristics; a remediation owner and timeline have been assigned." Avoid liability language.

sara: Where to store templates: incidents/docs/comms-templates.md and put a status-page snippet for quick copy/paste. Also add a PR checklist: redaction? legal review? attach metric images?

marcus: Action items (owner + unix due): 1) ivy: post public blurb within 24h (owner: ivy, due: 2487659900) 2) leo + eng-lead: draft tech addendum template (owner: leo, due: 2487822000) 3) sara: add templates + PR checklist to repo (owner: sara, due: 2487665000) 4) ops-bot: enable nightly similarity job once eng-ml endpoint shared (owner: ops-bot, due: 2487720000)

ops-bot: I will add nightly similarity checks and auto-label threads that meet the recurrence thresholds. Need eng-ml scoring endpoint and permission to label.

leo: I'll sync with eng-ml tomorrow to share scoring signature.

ivy: I'll post the public blurb now and paste link when live.

ops-bot: Public blurb posted to status page at 2487659800 (https://status.redwood.example/incident/2487654321)

marcus: Thanks all. I'll convert these into the comms SOP and create tracker entries. Leaving thread open for 1h for edits.

leo: ack.

ivy: all good.
